verses.en: Paul and Timotheus, the servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus which are at Philippi, with the bishops and deacons:
verses.pt: Paulo e Timóteo, servos de Cristo Jesus, a todos os santos em Cristo Jesus que estão em Filipos, com os bispos e diáconos:
verses.en_web: Paul and Timothy, servants of Jesus Christ; To all the saints in Christ Jesus who are at Philippi, with the overseers and servants:
verses.en_bbe: Paul and Timothy, servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus at Philippi, with the Bishops and Deacons of the church:

verses.en: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.pt: Graça a vós, e paz da parte de Deus nosso Pai, e do Senhor Jesus Cristo.
verses.en_web: Grace to you, and peace from God, our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.en_bbe: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.en: I thank my God upon every remembrance of you,
verses.pt: Dou graças ao meu Deus todas as vezes que me lembro de vós,
verses.en_web: I thank my God whenever I remember you,
verses.en_bbe: I give praise to my God at every memory of you,

verses.en: Always in every prayer of mine for you all making request with joy,
verses.pt: fazendo sempre, em todas as minhas orações, súplicas por todos vós com alegria
verses.en_web: always in every request of mine on behalf of you all, making my requests with joy,
verses.en_bbe: And in all my prayers for you all, making my request with joy,

verses.en: For your fellowship in the gospel from the first day until now;
verses.pt: pela vossa cooperação a favor do evangelho desde o primeiro dia até agora;
verses.en_web: for your partnership in furtherance of the Good News from the first day until now;
verses.en_bbe: Because of your help in giving the good news from the first day till now;

verses.en: Being confident of this very thing, that he which hath begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ:
verses.pt: tendo por certo isto mesmo, que aquele que em vós começou a boa obra a aperfeiçoará até o dia de Cristo Jesus,
verses.en_web: being confident of this very thing, that he who began a good work in you will complete it until the day of Jesus Christ.
verses.en_bbe: For I am certain of this very thing, that he by whom the good work was started in you will make it complete till the day of Jesus Christ:

verses.en: Even as it is meet for me to think this of you all, because I have you in my heart; inasmuch as both in my bonds, and in the defence and confirmation of the gospel, ye all are partakers of my grace.
verses.pt: como tenho por justo sentir isto a respeito de vós todos, porque vos retenho em meu coração, pois todos vós sois participantes comigo da graça, tanto nas minhas prisões como na defesa e confirmação do evangelho.
verses.en_web: It is even right for me to think this way on behalf of all of you, because I have you in my heart, because, both in my bonds and in the defense and confirmation of the Good News, you all are partakers with me of grace.
verses.en_bbe: So it is right for me to take thought for you all in this way, because I have you in my heart; for in my chains, and in my arguments before the judges in support of the good news, making clear that it is true, you all have your part with me in grace.

verses.en: For God is my record, how greatly I long after you all in the bowels of Jesus Christ.
verses.pt: Pois Deus me é testemunha de que tenho saudades de todos vós, na terna misericórdia de Cristo Jesus.
verses.en_web: For God is my witness, how I long after all of you in the tender mercies of Christ Jesus.
verses.en_bbe: For God is my witness, how my love goes out to you all in the loving mercies of Christ Jesus.

verses.en: And this I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and in all judgment;
verses.pt: E isto peço em oração: que o vosso amor aumente mais e mais no pleno conhecimento e em todo o discernimento,
verses.en_web: This I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and all discernment;
verses.en_bbe: And my prayer is that you may be increased more and more in knowledge and experience;

verses.en: That ye may approve things that are excellent; that ye may be sincere and without offence till the day of Christ;
verses.pt: para que aproveis as coisas excelentes, a fim de que sejais sinceros, e sem ofensa até o dia de Cristo;
verses.en_web: so that you may approve the things that are excellent; that you may be sincere and without offense to the day of Christ;
verses.en_bbe: So that you may give your approval to the best things; that you may be true and without wrongdoing till the day of Christ;

verses.en: Being filled with the fruits of righteousness, which are by Jesus Christ, unto the glory and praise of God.
verses.pt: cheios do fruto de injustiça, que vem por meio de Jesus Cristo, para glória e louvor de Deus.
verses.en_web: being filled with the fruits of righteousness, which are through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.
verses.en_bbe: Being full of the fruits of righteousness, which are through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.

verses.en: But I would ye should understand, brethren, that the things which happened unto me have fallen out rather unto the furtherance of the gospel;
verses.pt: E quero, irmãos, que saibais que as coisas que me aconteceram têm antes contribuido para o progresso do evangelho;
verses.en_web: Now I desire to have you know, brothers, that the things which happened to me have turned out rather to the progress of the Good News;
verses.en_bbe: Now it is my purpose to make clear to you, brothers, that the cause of the good news has been helped by my experiences;

verses.en: So that my bonds in Christ are manifest in all the palace, and in all other places;
verses.pt: de modo que se tem tornado manifesto a toda a guarda pretoriana e a todos os demais, que é por Cristo que estou em prisões;
verses.en_web: so that it became evident to the whole palace guard, and to all the rest, that my bonds are in Christ;
verses.en_bbe: So that it became clear through all the Praetorium, and to all the rest, that I was a prisoner on account of Christ;

verses.en: And many of the brethren in the Lord, waxing confident by my bonds, are much more bold to speak the word without fear.
verses.pt: também a maior parte dos irmãos no Senhor, animados pelas minhas prisões, são muito mais corajosos para falar sem temor a palavra de Deus.
verses.en_web: and that most of the brothers in the Lord, being confident through my bonds, are more abundantly bold to speak the word of God without fear.
verses.en_bbe: And most of the brothers in the Lord, taking heart because of my chains, are all the stronger to give the word of God without fear.

verses.en: Some indeed preach Christ even of envy and strife; and some also of good will:
verses.pt: Verdade é que alguns pregam a Cristo até por inveja e contenda, mas outros o fazem de boa mente;
verses.en_web: Some indeed preach Christ even out of envy and strife, and some also out of good will.
verses.en_bbe: Though some are preaching Christ out of envy and competition, others do it out of a good heart:

verses.en: The one preach Christ of contention, not sincerely, supposing to add affliction to my bonds:
verses.pt: estes por amor, sabendo que fui posto para defesa do evangelho;
verses.en_web: The former insincerely preach Christ from selfish ambition, thinking that they add affliction to my chains;
verses.en_bbe: These do it from love, conscious that I am responsible for the cause of the good news:

verses.en: But the other of love, knowing that I am set for the defence of the gospel.
verses.pt: mas aqueles por contenda anunciam a Cristo, não sinceramente, julgando suscitar aflição às minhas prisões.
verses.en_web: but the latter out of love, knowing that I am appointed for the defense of the Good News.
verses.en_bbe: But those are preaching Christ in a spirit of competition, not from their hearts, but with the purpose of giving me pain in my prison.

verses.en: What then? notwithstanding, every way, whether in pretence, or in truth, Christ is preached; and I therein do rejoice, yea, and will rejoice.
verses.pt: Mas que importa? contanto que, de toda maneira, ou por pretexto ou de verdade, Cristo seja anunciado, nisto me regozijo, sim, e me regozijarei;
verses.en_web: What does it matter? Only that in every way, whether in pretense or in truth, Christ is proclaimed. I rejoice in this, yes, and will rejoice.
verses.en_bbe: What then? only that in every way, falsely or truly, the preaching of Christ goes on; and in this I am glad, and will be glad.

verses.en: For I know that this shall turn to my salvation through your prayer, and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,
verses.pt: porque sei que isto me resultará em salvação, pela vossa súplica e pelo socorro do Espírito de Jesus Cristo,
verses.en_web: For I know that this will turn out to my salvation, through your prayers and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,
verses.en_bbe: For I am conscious that this will be for my salvation, through your prayer and the giving out of the stored wealth of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,

verses.en: According to my earnest expectation and my hope, that in nothing I shall be ashamed, but that with all boldness, as always, so now also Christ shall be magnified in my body, whether it be by life, or by death.
verses.pt: segundo a minha ardente expectativa e esperança, de que em nada serei confundido; antes, com toda a ousadia, Cristo será, tanto agora como sempre, engrandecido no meu corpo, seja pela vida, seja pela morte.
verses.en_web: according to my earnest expectation and hope, that I will in no way be disappointed, but with all boldness, as always, now also Christ will be magnified in my body, whether by life, or by death.
verses.en_bbe: In the measure of my strong hope and belief that in nothing will I be put to shame, but that without fear, as at all times, so now will Christ have glory in my body, by life or by death.

verses.en: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.
verses.pt: Porque para mim o viver é Cristo, e o morrer é lucro.
verses.en_web: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.
verses.en_bbe: For to me life is Christ and death is profit.

verses.en: But if I live in the flesh, this is the fruit of my labour: yet what I shall choose I wot not.
verses.pt: Mas, se o viver na carne resultar para mim em fruto do meu trabalho, não sei então o que hei de escolher.
verses.en_web: But if I live on in the flesh, this will bring fruit from my work; yet I don’t know what I will choose.
verses.en_bbe: But if I go on living in the flesh--if this is the fruit of my work--then I do not see what decision to make.

verses.en: For I am in a strait betwixt two, having a desire to depart, and to be with Christ; which is far better:
verses.pt: Mas de ambos os lados estou em aperto, tendo desejo de partir e estar com Cristo, porque isto é ainda muito melhor;
verses.en_web: But I am in a dilemma between the two, having the desire to depart and be with Christ, which is far better.
verses.en_bbe: I am in a hard position between the two, having a desire to go away and be with Christ, which is very much better:

verses.en: Nevertheless to abide in the flesh is more needful for you.
verses.pt: todavia, por causa de vós, julgo mais necessário permanecer na carne.
verses.en_web: Yet, to remain in the flesh is more needful for your sake.
verses.en_bbe: Still, to go on in the flesh is more necessary because of you.

verses.en: And having this confidence, I know that I shall abide and continue with you all for your furtherance and joy of faith;
verses.pt: E, tendo esta confiança, sei que ficarei, e permanecerei com todos vós para vosso progresso e gozo na fé;
verses.en_web: Having this confidence, I know that I will remain, yes, and remain with you all, for your progress and joy in the faith,
verses.en_bbe: And being certain of this, I am conscious that I will go on, yes, and go on with you all, for your growth and joy in the faith;

verses.en: That your rejoicing may be more abundant in Jesus Christ for me by my coming to you again.
verses.pt: para que o motivo de vos gloriardes cresça por mim em Cristo Jesus, pela minha presença de novo convosco.
verses.en_web: that your rejoicing may abound in Christ Jesus in me through my presence with you again.
verses.en_bbe: So that your pride in me may be increased in Christ Jesus through my being present with you again.

verses.en: Only let your conversation be as it becometh the gospel of Christ: that whether I come and see you, or else be absent, I may hear of your affairs, that ye stand fast in one spirit, with one mind striving together for the faith of the gospel;
verses.pt: Somente portai-vos, dum modo digno do evangelho de Cristo, para que, quer vá e vos veja, quer esteja ausente, ouça acerca de vós que permaneceis firmes num só espírito, combatendo juntamente com uma só alma pela fé do evangelho;
verses.en_web: Only let your way of life be worthy of the Good News of Christ, that, whether I come and see you or am absent, I may hear of your state, that you stand firm in one spirit, with one soul striving for the faith of the Good News;
verses.en_bbe: Only let your behaviour do credit to the good news of Christ, so that if I come and see you or if I am away from you, I may have news of you that you are strong in one spirit, working together with one soul for the faith of the good news;

verses.en: And in nothing terrified by your adversaries: which is to them an evident token of perdition, but to you of salvation, and that of God.
verses.pt: e que em nada estais atemorizados pelos adversários, o que para eles é indício de perdição, mas para vós de salvação, e isso da parte de Deus;
verses.en_web: and in nothing frightened by the adversaries, which is for them a proof of destruction, but to you of salvation, and that from God.
verses.en_bbe: Having no fear of those who are against you; which is a clear sign of their destruction, but of your salvation, and that from God;

verses.en: For unto you it is given in the behalf of Christ, not only to believe on him, but also to suffer for his sake;
verses.pt: pois vos foi concedido, por amor de Cristo, não somente o crer nele, mas também o padecer por ele,
verses.en_web: Because it has been granted to you on behalf of Christ, not only to believe in him, but also to suffer on his behalf,
verses.en_bbe: Because to you it has been given in the cause of Christ not only to have faith in him, but to undergo pain on his account:

verses.en: Having the same conflict which ye saw in me, and now hear to be in me.
verses.pt: tendo o mesmo combate que já em mim tendes visto e agora ouvis que está em mim.
verses.en_web: having the same conflict which you saw in me, and now hear is in me.
verses.en_bbe: Fighting the same fight which you saw in me, and now have word of in me.
